title: Shortest Distance in a Plane
prompt: Find the shortest distance between any two points in the plane. Return one column named shortest with the distance rounded to 2 decimal places.
expected_query: SELECT ROUND(MIN(SQRT(POWER(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + POWER(p1.y - p2.y, 2))), 2) AS shortest FROM points p1 CROSS JOIN points p2 WHERE p1.id < p2.id;
explanation: Generate every unique pair with CROSS JOIN and p1.id < p2.id. Calculate each Euclidean distance, take the minimum, and round the result to 2 decimals.
hints: Use CROSS JOIN with two aliases of the points table.
Use p1.id < p2.id to avoid self-pairs and duplicate mirrored pairs.
Use MIN to keep only the shortest distance.
common_mistakes: Using p1.id <> p2.id, which keeps duplicate mirrored pairs.
Rounding each coordinate difference instead of the final distance.
Returning the point IDs when the prompt only asks for the shortest distance.
